question: Do you have any plans to publish the “Aganau Route” as a book in the future?
answer:
I think it turned out quite well, but it was created in the way it was created, so I don't plan to publish that same IF story as a book.

If I were to publish an IF story as a book, it would be a different story.

I hope you'll enjoy it as an experiment in Re:Zero - Lost in Memories -!
